The main takeaway from our work is that

the effectivity of the human problem solving is not a result of some magical cognitive processes but rather of the combination of the following factors: (1) human cognitive mechanisms are very powerful, (2) human problem solvers are able to use these cognitive mechanisms to drive their problem solving process, and (3) human problem solvings are able to use a relatively small set cognitive mechanisms to solve problems effectively.
